name: Critters And Companions [Forge] 2.3.3 for 1.20.1

name: Critters And Companions [Forge] 2.3.2 for 1.20.1
changelog:
- Updated animations & textures of some animals
- Tamed ferrets now have dyeable collars
- Otters now drop held items when hit
- Added squish sound effect to grappling hook
- Fixed missing dumbo octopus bucket textures
- Lowered shima enaga sound volume
- Increased pearl necklace effectiveness
- Added new crafting recipes for enderpearls, slimeballs, and string
- Other small bug fixes and improvements

name: Critters And Companions [Forge] 2.3.1 for 1.20.1
changelog:
- Dragonfly armor now gives actual protection instead of modifying health
- Fixed jumping spiders attacking other animals owned by the same player
- Jumping spiders are now immune to poison
- Added a config system, right now only contains options to modify necklace values & the spawn values of mobs on fabric
- Decreased dragonfly spawn rate
- Fixed drowned only dropping clams

name: Critters And Companions [NeoForge] 2.3.0 for 1.20.1
changelog:
- Trinkets/curios support
-  Missing loot injects for fishing & drowned
- Fixed sea bunny slime not reducing fall damage
- Improved otter pathfinding
- Fixed jumping spiders not spawning
- Fixed rendering of some blocks on fabric
- Reworked otter AI a bit
- Sea bunny slime blocks allow to swim through again
- Other bug fixes

name: Critters And Companions [Neoforge] 2.2.2 for 1.20.1
changelog:
- Fixed fabric servers crashing when using a piston
- Fixed entity interactions from mods like easy villagers being always cancelled

name: Critters And Companions [Neoforge] 2.2.1 for 1.20.1

name: Critters And Companions [NeoForge]

- Fixed arachnophobia friendly resource pack visual bug
- Made leaf insects slightly more common
- Otters now have gradual passive regeneration
